phases.name: Lotus Nursery
phases.summary: Keep the lotus seedlings healthy while the permanent pond is built.

phases.name: Pond Selection
phases.summary: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan pond purchased from Wayfair for $146.19 all-in.

phases.name: Pump + Filter + Fountain
phases.summary: Option B selected and delivered: install and test the 300 GPH integrated pump/filter system.
requirements: Install and test the delivered 300 GPH integrated smartpond filter kit
Return the original small Smartpond kit
Add extra tubing or flow-control fittings only if installation requires them
Run fishless initially; consider UV later only for persistent green-water algae

phases.name: Pond Placement + Setup
phases.summary: Option 4 — Back Patio Window Wall selected; Manhattan pond delivered and placement/setup completed on the existing patio floor.

Sun, power and maintenance access confirmed
Existing patio floor requires no leveling or base work
Manhattan pond delivered September 2, 2026
Placement/setup completed

phases.name: Lotus + Buddha
phases.summary: Move the lotus into the permanent pond and finish the central Zen composition.
requirements: Transfer the established lotus into the Manhattan
Place Buddha beside the lotus
Keep the gentle fountain opposite the lotus
Preserve open reflective water

phases.name: Lighting + Finishing
phases.summary: Add restrained warm lighting and finish visible details after the pond is stable.
requirements: Add subtle Buddha accent lighting if desired
Keep pond lighting restrained
Hide and secure visible wiring and hardware

phases.name: Future Fish Decision
phases.summary: Decide whether a small fish population is appropriate after the pond has proven stable through Arizona seasons.
requirements: Review summer water temperature and oxygen
Confirm the biological filter is mature and adequate
Choose only a conservative number of small fish if conditions support them
Add testing, aeration or UV only if future conditions show they are needed

decisions.decision: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan 40-inch pond purchased from Wayfair.
Option B selected: one integrated smartpond 300 GPH pump/filter system from Lowe's for lower maintenance and simpler plumbing.
Option 4 — Back Patio Window Wall selected as the permanent pond location; placement/setup completed September 2026.
Removed from the pond project after selecting Option 4; there will be no jasmine or trellis around the pond.
Start fishless; revisit a small fish population in about one year.

maintenance.task: Remove debris/string algae and check water level
